property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the XMLPreference (a Application or Document).

property.name: deleteElementOnContentDeletion
property.shortdesc: The preference for deleting the element when deleting the associated content like a page item or a text fragment.

property.name: defaultStoryTagName
property.shortdesc: The name of the default tag to use for new story elements. Note: Either specifies an existing tag or creates a new tag.

property.name: defaultStoryTagColor
property.shortdesc: The color of the default story tag, specified either as an array of three doubles, each in the range 0 to 255 and representing R, G, and B values, or as a UI color. Notes: Valid only when default story tag name value creates a new tag. Does not update the color of an existing tag. Can return: Array of 3 Reals (0 - 255) or UIColors enumerator.

property.name: defaultTableTagName
property.shortdesc: The name of the default tag to use for new table elements. Note: Either specifies an existing tag or creates a new tag.

property.name: defaultTableTagColor
property.shortdesc: The color of the default table tag, specified either as an array of three doubles, each in the range 0 to 255 and representing R, G, and B values, or as a UI color. Notes: Valid only when default table tag name value creates a new tag. Does not update the color of an existing tag. . Can return: Array of 3 Reals (0 - 255) or UIColors enumerator.

property.name: defaultCellTagName
property.shortdesc: The name of the default tag to use for new table cell elements. Note: Either specifies an existing tag or creates a new tag.

property.name: defaultCellTagColor
property.shortdesc: The color of the default cell tag, specified either as an array of three doubles, each in the range 0 to 255 and representing R, G, and B values, or as a UI color. Note: Valid only when default cell tag name value creates a new tag. Does not update the color of an existing tag. . Can return: Array of 3 Reals (0 - 255) or UIColors enumerator.

property.name: defaultImageTagName
property.shortdesc: The default name for new image elements created automatically.

property.name: defaultImageTagColor
property.shortdesc: The color to give a new image tag, specified either as an array of three doubles, each in the range 0 to 255 and representing R, G, and B values, or as a UI color. Note: Used only when the tag needs to be created. Can return: Array of 3 Reals (0 - 255) or UIColors enumerator.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the XMLPreference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
